name: Otohime
source:
"You know, I've never been once unhappy, not since the day I was born."

From the tale "Urashima Taro."

The ruler of the Dragon Palace, a splendid palace sitting at the bottom of the sea. While she seems attractive and mysterious, she can be quite prim, and quite blunt.

[From [url=https://adabanaitan.com/en/]ANIPLEX.EXE[/url]]
